name: Google Document Column Mapping
description: One column of a rendered child table. Tagged with the Table Marker it belongs to (Frappe grids cannot nest, so columns live in a flat grid on the template). Row order = column order.

fields.label: Table Marker
fields.description: Which table this column belongs to, e.g. {{items_table}}. Must match a Table Mapping row.

fields.label: Child Fieldname
fields.description: Fieldname on the child row, e.g. item_code.

fields.label: Type
fields.options:
Data
Small Text
Text
Date
Datetime
Currency
Float
Int
Percent
Check

fields.label: Width (pt)
fields.description: Optional fixed column width in points.
